verdicts.reason: The two candidates look the same except for the top-left half-circle, which is a little bigger in B. That difference doesn't change the quality of either one. Both share the same flaws. The headline was moved below the photo, but the white bar and the gold underline that sat behind it stayed on the face, where they float with no text and look like artifacts. The decorative half-circle, dots and gold L-bracket make a disconnected column on the left. The vertical gold rule from the original is gone. The headline is pushed into the bottom-right corner while large empty areas sit at the top and in the middle.
